title: Tooltip
description: A CSS visual hint on hover and focus for redundant information. Use a headless tooltip when accessible announcement or dismissal is required

props.name: label
props.description: Tooltip: redundant visual hint. Essential information needs an accessible behavior layer.

props.name: placement
props.description: Tooltip: preferred side of the trigger; defaults to above.

props.name: align
props.description: Tooltip: preferred horizontal alignment; defaults to center.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Tooltip: allow a longer hint to wrap; defaults to false.

props.name: children
props.description: Tooltip: content containing a focusable trigger, such as a native button or TooltipTrigger.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: TooltipTrigger only: native tab stop; defaults to 0. The trigger is a span, not an action button.
